card.name: Drugs that affect a body system
card.fires_on: The word 'drugs' (or 'that' right after it) in phrases like 'other drugs that may affect...', just before a clause saying what the drugs act on. It appears in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: 'drugs' after other
modes.description: The word 'drugs' following 'other' in interaction warnings, before 'that affect...'.

modes.description: The word 'that' introducing a relative clause after 'drugs'.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says 'other drugs that affect...' something in the body.
